title: AI Adaptive Pentest: Intake Creates ai_loop Runs + Auto-Dispatch Passive Tasks
goal: The Intake wizard must offer a third run mode alongside Manual Wizard and AI Guided chat: 'AI Adaptive Pentest'. This mode creates a run with run_mode=ai_loop in configuration_json, no fixed phase chain. After the run is created, the assessment loop must dispatch passive tasks automatically without requiring operator intervention. Currently advance_assessment_loop() queues passive tasks with dispatch_mode='queued_not_dispatched' — this must be changed to actually dispatch them through the existing task dispatch path so the loop progresses on its own. Active/intrusive candidates continue to require operator approval (proposal flow).
generation_reason: The assessment_loop infrastructure exists but is never reached because Intake only creates standard runs or FULL-EXTERNAL-WEB chains. Passive queued tasks are never dispatched so the loop stalls immediately.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.no_bypass: Do not bypass approval gates for active or intrusive candidates. Only passive tier tasks may be auto-dispatched.
constraints.no_scope_violation: All dispatched tasks must respect the run's approved scope and ROE.
constraints.kill_switch: The kill switch must remain authoritative — check execution_kill_switch_enabled before dispatching.
constraints.existing_tests_must_pass: pytest api/tests/ must pass without modification to existing tests.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Keep implementation bounded to this task package. Defer broader scanner, exploit-chain, UI, or runtime work to separately queued packages.

implementation_notes.intake_change: Add a third tab/mode in Intake.tsx: 'AI Adaptive' that builds a run request with configuration_json.run_mode='ai_loop' and configuration_json.assessment_loop.enabled=true. No assessment_mode chain. dispatch_after_create=true.
implementation_notes.dispatch_fix: In assessment_loop.py _queue_passive_loop_task(), after creating and flushing the task, call dispatch_task_execution(task.id, settings) if settings are available. Alternatively, in _maybe_advance_assessment_loop_after_task() in tasks.py, after advance_assessment_loop() returns a queued passive task, dispatch it using existing dispatch_task_batch().
implementation_notes.preferred_dispatch_location: tasks.py is cleaner: after _maybe_advance_assessment_loop_after_task() returns, check if result contains queued_task_id and dispatch it via dispatch_task_batch([queued_task_id], settings).

acceptance_criteria: Intake shows AI Adaptive mode option.
Selecting AI Adaptive and launching creates a run with configuration_json.run_mode='ai_loop'.
After the first task completes, advance_assessment_loop() is called and the next passive candidate task is dispatched automatically without operator input.
Active/intrusive candidates remain as pending proposals requiring approval.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
after_completion: Promote the next true open task into NEXT_TASK.md, or record that no active backlog task remains.

out_of_scope: Running live public target scans without explicit operator authorization and approved scope.
Bypassing approval gates, scope/ROE boundaries, runtime binding, credential protections, or kill-switch behavior.
Materializing credentials or sensitive data outside protected references.
Auto-approving active, intrusive, exploit, or destructive follow-up actions.
